title: review (other model, opus, security checklist): C-O5 fix round 2 on task/T-0178 — delta 94d5e32..156e120 (T-0178, executed by claude:sonnet)
spec: Review ONLY the T-0178 delta: `git diff 94d5e32 156e120` in worktree wt/T-0178 (Dockerfile, docker-compose.executor.yml, .dockerignore, .gitignore, docs/executor-host.md). Fix round for review T-0176 plus the multi-arch decision; confirm: (1) .dockerignore excludes only /.mcp.json among mcp configs, plus work/ and .env; the executor's build evidence says /opt/orchestrator/.mcp.planner.json is in the image (trust the recorded evidence, do not build); (2) .gitignore ignores work/, config/, .env; (3) Dockerfile: no --platform pin, FROM pinned to a multi-arch manifest-list digest with a bump comment, codex asset chosen by dpkg architecture (x86_64 / aarch64 musl) with a checksum per arch and a build failure on other arches, installer scripts hashed before execution, comment on what is verified; (4) compose build args read ORCH_UID/ORCH_GID with defaults, .env documented; (5) runbook: .env step, healthz via docker compose exec from the host, prerequisites Compose v2.24+ and BuildKit, native build per host, no stale platform advice. Re-check the T-0173 guarantees survive (concrete ~/orch-creds protected path, external ORCH_NET network, config mounts read-only, hardening options, no ports) and re-apply the security checklist to the changed lines; run the objective secret grep over the diff. Third review of the executor image: approve unless a defect would break the container in production or weaken the credential story; smaller points as notes. Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments.
acceptance: Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments
Each of the five groups confirmed resolved or named unresolved with evidence
T-0173 guarantees confirmed; secret grep clean

comments.issue: Nothing gives git an identity in the container, so every goal dies on its first write. goals.py:104 runs `git commit --only` in the clone (bus.py:183 likewise). No `git config` in the Dockerfile, no ~/.gitconfig baked or mounted (compose:15-22), no GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* in executor.env (docs:79-83), and step 7's `gh auth login` sets credentials, not identity. Git cannot auto-detect: useradd sets no GECOS (Dockerfile:47-48) -> empty ident name; container hostname has no domain -> 'unable to auto-detect email address (got orch@<id>.(none))'. Fails closed as a 422 via goals.py:105-106, but POST /goals never succeeds - exactly what step 9 smoke-tests. Repo grep: user.email/name set only in tests/_harness.py:48-49.

COPY --chown=orch:orch . /opt/orchestrator makes the orchestrator code and hooks writable by the same orch user every agent runs as, protected by nothing. The image's protected-paths.txt still names host-relative ~/code/orchestrator/.claude/hooks|settings.json|protected-paths.txt (:14-17), nonexistent in the container, and install.py:42-55 rewrites those three lines to the target repo. So /opt/orchestrator/.claude/hooks (the source copy_tree_always at install.py:134 pushes into every future target) and /opt/orchestrator/orchestrator/*.py are in no guardrail list; Codex also runs dangerous_full_access. Group 1 holds for the cred mounts, not for the install itself.

executor.env template omits GH_WRITE_TOKEN, but the pool.toml copied in step 5 carries [secrets.planner] GH_WRITE_TOKEN = "env:GH_WRITE_TOKEN" and step 5's snippet shows only the scout/review GH_READ_TOKEN lines. spawn.py:85-89 skips an unset env: secret with a warning instead of failing, so the Planner launches and then silently cannot open the goal/<parent> -> main PR that closes every goal. The template is presented as complete.

The uv (:58-61) and Claude Code (:91-95) installer scripts are sha256sum'd into the build log but never compared, so the hash is an artifact, not a control - a swapped install.sh builds green. Weaker than the codex tarball beside it, which does enforce sha256sum -c (:76). Also re-fetched on every rebuild: COPY at :81 sits above the Claude install, so any source edit busts the layer and re-downloads claude.ai/install.sh. Add optional ARG *_INSTALL_SHA256 with sha256sum -c, and/or move COPY below the installer RUNs.

/home/orch/.config does not exist in the image, so Docker auto-creates the bind-mount parent as root:root 0755; orch can then create no sibling under ~/.config, and cap_drop ALL (:31-32) plus no-new-privileges leaves no runtime fix. Latent today (claude uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, codex ~/.codex, uv ~/.local + ~/.cache) but fails opaquely the first time a tool falls back to XDG. Add RUN install -d -o orch -g orch /home/orch/.config.

result.summary: request_changes. Groups: (1) protected-paths RESOLVED (protected-paths.txt:38-42 concrete root + 4 container paths; install.py:119-121 propagates, _rewrite_protected_paths swaps only the 3 self lines). (2) compose RESOLVED (ORCH_UID/ORCH_GID :9-10, :? guards :19-22/:39, :ro config matching serve.py:43 + goals.py:269, env_file required, no ports, no-new-privileges, cap_drop ALL, mem 6g, pids 512). (3) runbook RESOLVED for all four doc defects (Compose v2.24+ :10, native builds :14-16, .env instead of export GID :18-31, docker compose exec healthz :183-189). (4) Dockerfile RESOLVED (no --platform, manifest-list digest, codex sha256 -c :76, USER orch, entrypoint passthrough). (5) .dockerignore RESOLVED (/.mcp.json anchored :4 so the 4 tracked role configs ship for install.py:156; work/ + config/ :15-16; .gitignore gained work/, config/, .env). T-0173 guarantees present. Secret grep CLEAN: only var names, <paste here>, $ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN refs. Checklist: serve fails closed without ORCH_SERVICE_TOKEN (serve.py:310), hmac.compare_digest (:99), clone stderr redacted. Blocker is new, not a group regression: no git identity in the container.
